Roth.theta_lt_succ_aux✝ {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ : δ ≤ 1 / (↑n + 1 + 1)) {r q : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ}
  (hrlast : 3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last (n + 1)))) (hratio : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc))
  (hq1 : (↑n + 1 + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1 + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0))
  (hqr : ∀ (j : Fin (n + 2)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j))
  (ih :
    ∀ {δ : ℝ},
      0 < δ →
        δ ≤ 1 / (↑n + 1) →
          ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
            3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
              (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
                (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
                  (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                    Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)) :
  Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 2) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2)

private theorem Roth.theta_lt_succ_aux : ∀ {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ 1 / (↑n + 1 + 1) →
      ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 2) → ℕ},
        3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last (n + 1))) →
          (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
            (↑n + 1 + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1 + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
              (∀ (j : Fin (n + 2)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                (∀ {δ : ℝ},
                    0 < δ →
                      δ ≤ 1 / (↑n + 1) →
                        ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
                          3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
                              (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
                                (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                                  Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)) →
                  Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 2) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 2) :=
fun {n} {δ} hδ0 hδ {r q} hrlast hratio hq1 hqr ih ↦
  have hδ1 :=
    LE.le.trans_lt hδ
      ((div_lt_one
            (add_pos'
              (Right.add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (Nat.cast_nonneg' n)
                (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                  (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1))))
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1))))).mpr
        (lt_of_not_ge fun a ↦
          Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith.lt_irrefl
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a < 0)
                (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq
                  (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.add_congr
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_congr
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.cast_pos (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one))
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_add

                            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isInt_neg (Eq.refl Neg.neg)
                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isInt (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw ℝ 1))
                              (Eq.refl (Int.negOfNat 1))))
                          Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_zero))
                      (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_congr
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.cast_zero (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero))
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.atom_pf (↑n) rfl
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1 = ↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * _a)
                                (Eq.symm rfl)))
                            (Eq.refl (↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                        (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_pf
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_add
                            (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.neg_mul (↑n) (Nat.rawCast 1)
                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsInt.to_raw_eq
                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isInt_neg (Eq.refl Neg.neg)
                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_isInt (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.of_raw ℝ 1))
